definitions.primary_rate: sum(tokens) / sum(source video duration seconds), per question evaluation
definitions.elapsed_rate: sum(tokens) / sum(saved elapsed_seconds), end-to-end worker processing rate
definitions.question_mean: arithmetic mean of individual question token/time ratios
definitions.input_text: all nonvisual input IDs, including timestamps, vision boundaries and chat template
definitions.elapsed_scope: video probing/extraction/decoding/preprocessing, transfer, generation, scoring; first question includes model loading; excludes worker startup and final summary
definitions.mean_total_text: mean(text input + generated text output), including EOS
definitions.mean_all_tokens: mean(visual input + text input + generated text output)
definitions.incomplete: rates only if latest-attempt coverage strictly exceeds partial_coverage_threshold; otherwise no rates
definitions.partial: validated observed prefix of latest attempt only; remains incomplete; no extrapolation or merging retries
definitions.invalid_partial: saved coverage is shown, but rates withheld after validation failure, including non-EOS generations
definitions.selection: one certified completion, otherwise the largest latest-attempt prefix across compatible matrices; never concatenate retries
definitions.prediction_snapshot_sha256: canonical JSON digest of parsed prediction rows used for a partial measurement, excluding any unfinished final JSONL record
